Positioned at 2210 E Central Texas Expy Suite 205 in Killeen, this approximately 900 square foot office suite offers a professional setting within a well-established commercial building. The suite layout is thoughtfully designed to support daily operations, featuring multiple private offices, a dedicated reception area, and a conference space that accommodates both client meetings and team collaboration. Large window lines bring in natural light, enhancing the overall workspace and contributing to a comfortable, productive atmosphere for employees and visitors alike.

Interior photos are coming soon and will provide additional insight into the space and layout. With its strategic positioning, efficient floor plan, and professional environment, Suite 205 offers an excellent opportunity for businesses looking to strengthen their presence and operate effectively within the Killeen market.
